properties.name: marz.enabled
properties.description: Enable MARZ auto-configuration. Set to false to disable all MARZ processing.

properties.name: marz.default-poll-interval-ms
properties.description: Default poll interval in milliseconds. Minimum 500ms.

properties.name: marz.thread-pool-size
properties.description: Polling thread pool size. 0 = auto-size based on source count and available processors.

properties.name: marz.default-source
properties.description: Default config source URI for fields using platform://marz source.
